errors.text_span: The horizontal axis lists nine distinct LLMs
errors.evidence: The chart clearly displays 12 bars, not nine. This statement is factually incorrect and also contradicts the later part of the same sentence which proceeds to list 12 bar values.

errors.text_span: the third (purple) 9.60%, the fourth (pink) 11.37%, the fifth (light blue) 28.29%, the sixth (brown) 18.80%, the seventh (light cyan) 21.88%, the eighth (beige) 23.79%, the ninth (gray) 17.27%, the tenth (light green) 22.41%
errors.evidence: Several colors are misidentified in the list. For example, the third bar (9.60%) is blue, not purple. The eighth bar (23.79%) is light purple/lavender, not beige. The ninth bar (17.27%) is tan/beige, not gray. The tenth bar (22.41%) is light gray, not light green.
The description fails to mention that the horizontal axis, which represents the different categories, has no visible labels. It instead incorrectly states that it lists the LLMs.
